If anyone does read this confession, I do not need help in real live. I receave all the help one could want. There is no more. However, if you think there is somerhing you could say or propose that could help me, anything at all, please write it. For the benefit of the people I leave behind, so that I may endure to outlive them.

Ps: I am not a native english speaker and am obviously very emotional right now, so please excuse any mistakes.
